server.description:
Protocol Events

`GET /gateway/schema` publishes these as JSON Schema; variants marked `schemars(skip)` only travel between our own services.

oneOf.description: Multiple events

Successfully authenticated
Logged out
Basic data to cache

The session can't be resumed; send `Authenticate` on this socket for a new one (and catch up over the API)
Ping response
Release the bees.
New message

oneOf.description: Continue a dropped resumable session: the events after `seq` that the client may still see are sent again, then `Resumed`. Answered with `InvalidSession { resumable: false }` when that is not possible.

close_codes.1005: Closed without a code: logged out, or the session ended or expired (`Logout` came first). Authenticate again with a valid token.
close_codes.1013: Try again later: the bot could not be read (`Error` `InternalError` came first). Reconnect with backoff.
close_codes.4014: Disallowed intents: a privileged intent is not switched on for this bot (`Error` `MissingIntent` came first). Do not retry with the same intents.

resume.seq: Every event from the session's stream carries seq, from 1, one per packet (a Bulk has one; its items have none). Authenticated, Ready, UserSlowmodes, Pong, Error, InvalidSession and Resumed have none. Typing events get a seq but are not kept for a resume, so a replay has gaps there and where access was lost.
resume.flow: Authenticate { resumable: true } -> Ready { session_id }. After a drop, on a new socket: Resume { token, session_id, seq } -> the missed events the session may still see, in order, then Resumed; or InvalidSession { resumable: false } -> send Authenticate on the same socket and catch up over the API. Events dropped since (lost access) leave gaps in seq.
